title: UFO programs hidden under the Department of Energy
summary: Jesse Michels tells of UFO programs hidden under the Department of Energy, about 1954-present at Department of Energy, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: because I was told I think it was Chris Melon was telling me this that they hide things because anything nuclear would be national security.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says Chris Mellon, a former Pentagon intelligence official, told him that UFO programs are hidden inside the US Department of Energy. The reason, as Michels tells it, is the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, a law that makes anything nuclear a matter of national security, so putting the programs there keeps them locked away from outsiders.
